newsitem.title: MACEDONIA: Macedonian defence min visits Albania border.
newsitem.headline: Macedonian defence min visits Albania border.

text.p: Macedonian defence minister Blagoj Hadzioski toured his Balkan nation's border with Albania on Friday and said authority across the frontier had collapsed.
"There are too many people armed with various weapons, including hand grenades, and this includes little children," said Hadzioski, shown wearing a flak jacket on a border post by Macedonian TV.
"The situation along the entire Macedonian-Albanian border has deteriorated. Albanian authorities, both civilian, army and police, have collapsed along the entire border," he added.

Foreign troops and the terrified evacuees they were trying to rescue came under fire in Albania on Friday as thousands of expatriates scrambled to escape from growing lawlessness sweeping the Balkan state.
Macedonian TV on Friday evening showed footage of the Albanian border crossing across from Struga being looting by dozens of people.
Few Albanians and some Turkish travellers who managed to cross the border on Friday spoke of massive looting in the area.
